manifest.legacy_metric_fields: yes_minus_no/logp_yes/logp_no denote positive-minus-negative/positive/negative answers, regardless of answer spelling
manifest.condition_definition: Yes: read-only reference probe; No: no probe; both eval and no_grad
manifest.method: Fixed execution features; ridge correction of existing answer rows only
manifest.fit_targets: Individual answer logits from fixed pair mass and signed log odds

preservation.constraint: Both fitted answer logits retain pre-fit native values; many phase only

method: Native output rows (No/Yes); all internal weights fixed
intervals: 5000 whole-prompt paired bootstrap resamples; pointwise 95% intervals
limits: Conditional on this fit and prompts; excludes seed and hardware uncertainty

cluster_bootstrap.method: One-stage whole-family bootstrap; all member prompt pairs retained
cluster_bootstrap.estimand: Equal-weight mean over families; not weighted by family prompt count
cluster_bootstrap.limits: Conditional on one fit; assumes family units are exchangeable; does not establish transfer to arbitrary new task families
